description: This file contains utility functions for generating JavaScript code used for form validation and UI interactions within the SuiteCRM Document Revisions module. It includes functions to validate record data in forms, provide customized JavaScript snippets for specific form behaviors, and handle UI components such as tab selectors.

methods.name: get_validate_record_document_revision_js
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for client-side validation of document revision records, ensuring required fields like version and filename are filled.

methods.name: get_chooser_js
methods.description: Returns JavaScript code for handling the display tab chooser UI component.

methods.name: get_validate_record_js
methods.description: Produces JavaScript code for validating document record forms, including checks for document name, active date, filename, and revision, with special handling for new records.
